statement.text:
Let G = A ∗H B be the generalized free product of groups A and B with
amalgamated subgroup H. Is ψ(G) = 1 in the following cases?
  a) H is finite cyclic and HG = 1.
  b) H is finite cyclic and either λ(A) ∩ HG = 1 or λ(B) ∩ HG = 1.
  c) HG = 1 and H satisfies the minimum condition on subgroups.
  d) λ(G) ∩ H = 1.
  e) A and B are free groups, H is finitely generated and at least one of |A : H| or
     |B : H| is infinite.
  f) H is infinite cyclic and is a retract of A and B.
  g) G nearly splits over H, and H is a normal subgroup of G of prime order.
                                                                          M. K. Azarian
